subject: Atlas Medical — implementation MAP, cutover windows & owner commitments
messages:
From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@atlas-med.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Medical Onboarding <onboard@atlas-med.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood trial — next steps and cutover windows

Rafael, thanks for the demo yesterday — team liked the low latency and the per-route cost breakdown. We're aiming to finalize the SOW this month and need a practical timeline that shows who owns which milestones so we can get governance approval.

Quick asks from my side:
- A clear go-live window (2–3 options) we can present at exec.
- Owner for data ingestion (we have a small ETL team).
- Confirm whether private deployment is needed for PHI (likely yes).

Can you send a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and a kickoff agenda?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Lawson
Head of Digital Integration | Atlas Medical
attachment: PHI-requirements-summary.pdf (referenced)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@atlas-med.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RE: Redwood trial — next steps and cutover windows

Team — forwarding Emma's ask. I sketched a draft MAP and two possible go-live windows (see attachment). High level:
- Week-of-2026-06-21 (preferred): pilot cutover to dedicated pool for a single workflow, then expand.
- Week-of-2026-07-19 (fallback): allows more security work (KMS/HSM + SOC2 evidence).

Primary open items I need you to pick owners for:
1) Data ingestion & ETL testing — needs an internal owner to coordinate with Atlas's ETL team.
2) Private deployment checklist (networking, KMS) — security lead to confirm minimum evidence.
3) Acceptance tests & performance SLOs — define token throughput, latency targets during pilot.

Attachments: Atlas-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes milestone rows, owners, rough dates. Kickoff-Agenda-2026-05-18.pdf.

Pls reply with flagged owner names and single-line commitments by EOD tomorrow so I can lock in the kickoff and send to Emma.

— Rafa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@atlas-med.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Redwood trial — next steps and cutover windows

Rafa/Marissa — I can own Data ingestion and ETL testing. I'll coordinate an initial sync with Atlas's ETL lead (Emma, can you share their calendar contact or a primary email?).

Proposed quick milestones on my side (to include in MAP):
- 2026-05-20: Data schema alignment and sample file exchange.
- 2026-06-01: Sanity ingest + smoke tests on staging.
- 2026-06-18: Full ingest + performance validation for pilot.

I'll add these to Atlas-MAP-v1.xlsx and flag dependencies.

— Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@atlas-med.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Redwood trial — next steps and cutover windows

I'll take the private deployment checklist (network + KMS/HSM confirmations). Action items:
- 2026-05-14: Security kickoff (30 min) — runbook + required artifacts (SOC2, network diagram, KMS policy).
- 2026-05-21: Networking test window with Atlas infra (VPN & VPC peering test).
- 2026-06-15: Finalize private deploy config and pre-signed image.

Note on PHI: We should add a short exception path in the MAP for data that must remain on-prem. I'll capture this in the spreadsheet.

— Karthik

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@atlas-med.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Atlas MAP (v1) — owners and confirmed kickoff

Emma — attaching the v1 MAP (spreadsheet) and the kickoff agenda. Per the internal replies above, short confirmations:
- Data ingestion owner: Ben Carter — schedule shared for schema sync on 2026-05-20.
- Security/private deployment owner: Karthik Iyer — security kickoff 2026-05-14 (30 min).
- Acceptance tests & SLOs: Marissa Cole (CS) — will publish the acceptance checklist by 2026-05-17.

Proposed pilot cutover window: week of 2026-06-21. Fallback window: week of 2026-07-19.

Next steps for Atlas (please confirm by reply):
1) Confirm preferred pilot window (Jun 21 or Jul 19).
2) Share ETL primary contact (email).
3) Approve the kickoff agenda or suggest edits.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/56781234), MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAtlasMAP).

Thanks — I'll open a shared Jira (CSUP-421) for day-to-day tasks and will send a DocuSign SOW link once the window is approved.

Best,
